cases.name: introduced-methods-and-formats
cases.title: Atlas Retrieval Network
cases.text: We introduce Atlas Retrieval Network (ARN), a sparse retrieval architecture. We generate data with a procedure we call Agentic Self-Instruct. ARN uses a contrastive objective, and the contrastive objective improves retrieval. ARN outperforms baselines throughout training. Results comparing training are reported. The implementation emits JSON records, and JSON validation runs before evaluation.

cases.name: preference-optimization
cases.title: Direct Preference Optimization
cases.text: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) directly trains a policy from human preferences. DPO replaces a separate reward model, while the reward model remains useful background. DPO avoids reinforcement learning throughout training. The implementation stores JSON configuration and exports a PDF report.

cases.name: math-objective-and-boilerplate
cases.title: Focal Retrieval
cases.text: We optimize Focal Loss (FL) for retrieval. The focal loss objective emphasizes difficult examples, and the focal loss is evaluated in every ablation. Results comparing evaluation settings appear in the appendix. The API writes CSV tables and an HTML summary.
